{{Quote|You and Ven grab seats where you can keep an eye on me. But stay put. Don't do anything unless I give a sign.''"<br />"''Got it.|Reck Desh and Wotson|<ref name="HT" />}}
'''Ven''' was a member of the [[Peace Brigade]], a group of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] citizens that cooperated with the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaders during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="HT" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]'' to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].</ref> Ven served as [[Reck Desh]]'s [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] alongside a [[Gender/Legends|man]] named [[Wotson]] when Desh, the Peace Brigade's leader, traveled to [[Kuat City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. There, the trio entered the [[Nebula Orchid]] diner to meet an informant,<ref name="HT" /> secretly [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viqi Shesh]].<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> While Shesh told Desh of a captured [[Elan|Yuuzhan Vong priestess]], Ven and Wotson sat at a nearby table and kept watch. Ven, Desh, and Wotson pursued the informant into the streets after the meeting concluded, but lost sight of the person.<ref name="HT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ven appeared in [[2000]]'s ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]'', a novel written by [[James Luceno]] as the fourth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' series.<ref name="HT" />
